rdfs:label: width
rdfs:comment: The preferred display width, in device-independent (CSS) pixels, of the resource a Link points to; AS2 declares the domain as Link, though fediverse software also puts it on Image/Video/Document attachments.
notes: Device-independent (CSS) pixels — not necessarily the intrinsic pixel width of the media file. AS2's declared domain is Link; putting it directly on an Image/Video/Document (as in the example) is common fediverse practice outside that domain. Always declare alongside `as:height` — both together let renderers compute aspect ratios and pre-reserve layout space, avoiding cumulative layout shift when media loads asynchronously.

history.note: Comment/notes: device-independent (CSS) pixels on a Link; added rdfs:domain urn:solid:Link and noted fediverse use on attachments.
